label: If the Flashpoint
aiHint: Checks whether the active flashpoint has or does not have a tag. For generated drafts, prefer the Conditional input as a nested Get Preset Value (int) call using the HasOrHasNot preset.

inputs.label: Conditional
inputs.aiHint: Use Get Preset Value (int) with preset key HasOrHasNot. Value 1 means has; value 0 means doesn't have.

inputs.label: Tag Key
inputs.aiHint: Use the literal flashpoint tag key as a string unless it must come from another operation.
